label: early original-phase steps (t=2-4) after an h at sequence start
explanation: Fires only in the original phase at steps 2-4 (99.8% of mass; essentially never at t<2, t>=5, the delimiter, or copy). Activation is gated by an h at the start of the sequence: first_tok==h gives 15x lift and 80% of mass. With orig(0)==h, steps 2-3 fire with ~100% precision and cover nearly all top-quartile activations (max at t=3 for h h x _ sequences). An h at position 1 gives weaker activations at steps 3-4. Adding that case lifts mass recall to ~0.97 at precision ~0.71. The input token at the current step barely matters. Many low-magnitude misses are spread out (weak firing at t=2-4 with other first tokens such as digits 2/1), and these hold most of the unexplained count but little mass.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the first original token (most: h, 2, x, 1, 3, l; least: c, a, s, t) and the second original token (most: h, f, n, v, 1, u; least: o, q, p, t); timing cues that raise it most: t=2, t=3, t=4.
